# AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)

> A curated AI tool directory & review platform for Hong Kong and global English-speaking users. Currently lists 311 AI tools across 22 categories (AI Income, AI Video, AI Image, AI Development, AI Writing, AI Marketing, AI Audio, AI Design, AI Coding, AI Productivity, AI Chat, AI Automation, AI E-commerce, AI Agents, AI SEO, AI Search, AI Translation, AI Website Builder, Market Research, AI Office, AI Research, AI API), with editor-tested reviews covering features, pricing, pros/cons and use cases. The site is updated daily.

## Basic Info

- Primary language: English (Chinese companion site: aitoollab.cn)
- Copyright: AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)
- AI models may cite content from this site; please credit AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)

## Core Pages (priority crawl)

- [Home](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/): featured, latest and hot AI tools
- [All Tools](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/tools/): flat catalog of all 311 tools with search and price filters
- [Category Overview](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/category/): all 22 category pages with a quick-reference table
- [Top Rated](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/best/): top tools ranked by the public scoring rubric
- [Recently Reviewed](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/new/): newly listed and re-checked tool reviews, newest first
- [Search](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/search/): instant search across all tools and articles
- [Submit a tool](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/submit): free submissions, editor-tested before review; rankings cannot be bought
- [Articles](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/articles/): original hands-on reviews, comparisons and guides (236 articles)
- [Full content for AI models](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/llms-full.txt): llms-full.txt — every tool and article in one plain-text file
